title: Normalized total derived limit comparison and strict augmentation unit
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site with object universe $c$ and morphism universe $v$, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings of size $\max(c,v,r)$, with $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume abelian sheafification and the locally bijective criterion in this coefficient size. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of $\mathcal A$ and of the strict tower category $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] [def-weil-inverse-system], with localization functors $Q$ in a common localization universe $w$. Let $L=\operatorname{koszulRlim}_R$ be the specified total right derived inverse limit [def-sf-koszul-total-derived-limit]. Define $\operatorname{limitComparison}$ to be the right-derived comparison $\gamma:Q\lim\to LQ$ selected in the same right-derived pair as this specified functor. For a cochain complex $P$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], write $\Delta P$ for the constant strict tower and $X$ for the degreewise transposition of towers of complexes and their maps [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers]. Define the representative constant-tower unit by $\operatorname{constantUnit}(P)=\gamma_{X(\Delta P)}\circ Q(u_P)$, where $u_P:P\to\lim X(\Delta P)$ is the ordinary constant/limit adjunction unit on complexes. For any strict tower $V$ of such complexes and strict augmentation $\alpha:\Delta P\to V$, define $\operatorname{augmentedUnit}(P,V,\alpha)=L(Q(X(\alpha)))\circ\operatorname{constantUnit}(P):Q(P)\to L(Q(X(V)))$. These are the specified representative formulas, without any regularity, K-flatness, boundedness or exact-countable-product hypothesis.
